facts.text: 45 Park Lane is on Park Lane in Mayfair, overlooking Hyde Park.
facts.excerpt: 45 Park Lane is on Park Lane, London W1K 1PN, in the heart of Mayfair, overlooking Hyde Park.

facts.text: Hyde Park is a 3-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The park is just a 3-minute walk from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel is close to Buckingham Palace, the Royal Academy of Arts and Wellington Arch.
facts.excerpt: close to Buckingham Palace, Royal Academy of Arts, Wellington Arch and the main shopping districts in the heart of Mayfair

facts.text: The hotel is around 30 to 45 minutes by car from Heathrow Airport.
facts.excerpt: around 30-45 minutes by car from Heathrow Airport

facts.text: Every room faces Hyde Park.
facts.excerpt: Just 45 rooms, every one facing Hyde Park.

facts.text: The hotel was designed by Thierry Despont in a warm Art Deco style that feels more private residence than grand hotel.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Thierry Despont, its warm Art Deco style feels more private residence than grand hotel.

facts.text: The building once lived a life as a private residence whose artwork attracted visits from Noel Coward and T.E. Lawrence.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes it as the smallest Dorchester Collection property, with a more relaxed boutique feel than a formal grand hotel.
facts.excerpt: This is the smallest of the Dorchester Collection's properties and, as such, the vibe is more relaxed boutique than formal grand-dame.

facts.text: CUT at 45 Park Lane is Wolfgang Puck's first European restaurant.
facts.excerpt: It's home to CUT by Wolfgang Puck (his first European restaurant)

facts.text: CUT at 45 Park Lane is an American steak restaurant.

facts.text: Damien Hirst's Diamond Dust Psalms series hangs on the walls at CUT.

facts.excerpt: chef Shinji Kanesaka's first European restaurant
